capital.evidence_quote: Kigali is the capital and largest city of Rwanda, renowned as the cleanest city in Africa

currency.evidence_quote: The Rwandan Franc (RWF) is the official currency of the Republic of Rwanda

timezone.evidence_quote: Rwanda observes Central Africa Time UTC+2 year-round without daylight saving adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard domestic electrical supply in Rwanda operates at 230V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Operating electrical grid frequency in Rwanda is 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Outlets in Rwanda utilize European Type C and Swiss Type J plugs

police.evidence_quote: Dial 112 for emergency police intervention across Rwanda

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 912 for emergency SAMU medical assistance and ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 111 for fire and technical rescue emergency services

general.evidence_quote: 112 serves as the primary unified national emergency operator number

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist Protection Unit division provides dedicated safety patrols in Volcanoes and Nyungwe national parks

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Kigali ve Ruanda genelinde güvenlik seviyesi en üst düzeydedir; DRC sınır boylarında dikkatli olunmalıdır.
advisory_headline.en: Kigali is remarkably safe and clean; exercise normal travel precautions, staying mindful near the DRC border.
advisory_headline.de: Kigali ist außerordentlich sicher und sauber; normale Vorsichtsmaßnahmen genügen.
advisory_headline.ru: Кигали — один из самых безопасных и чистых городов мира; действуют обычные правила предосторожности.
advisory_headline.es: Kigali es extraordinariamente segura y limpia; aplican precauciones normales de viaje.

regional_warnings.area: Western Border with DRC (Rubavu/Goma border zone)
regional_warnings.reason: Occasional border friction and rebel conflicts across the border in eastern DRC.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Rwanda reach approximately 36.5 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Rwanda measure 52.4 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: MTN Rwanda and Airtel provide high-speed 4G prepaid tourist eSIMs. MTN Mobile Money (MoMo) is universally accepted everywhere. Single-use plastic bags are strictly prohibited by law.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: MTN MoMo mobile payment network is ubiquitous across all commerce in Rwanda

tr.conditions: Tüm dünya vatandaşları gibi Türk vatandaşları da Kigali Havalimanı'nda Kapıda Vize (VoA - 30 gün, 50$) alabilir veya Doğu Afrika Vizesi ($100) seçebilir.

source.title: Rwanda Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration

us.conditions: US citizens receive a 30-day Visa on Arrival upon arrival at Kigali International Airport ($50 USD).

de.conditions: German and EU citizens obtain a 30-day Visa on Arrival at the port of entry ($50 USD fee).

gb.conditions: British passport holders receive a 30-day tourist visa on arrival for a $50 USD fee.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ получают визу по прибытии в аэропорту Кигали на 30 дней за 50 долларов США.

dos.title: Respect the plastic bag ban (strictly enforced)
dos.description: Plastic carrier bags are illegal in Rwanda; baggage is searched at Kigali Airport, and paper or cloth bags are provided instead.

dos.title: Wear a helmet on motorcycle taxis (Motos)
dos.description: Every moto-taxi rider in Kigali carries a clean passenger helmet by law; wearing it is mandatory and strictly enforced.

dos.title: Observe Umuganda community day
dos.description: On the last Saturday morning of each month (08:00 - 11:00), public businesses pause for nationwide community service.

donts.title: Don't step on manicured public lawns
donts.description: Kigali takes civic pride in immaculate streets and flowers; walk on paved sidewalks and avoid walking across green lawns.

donts.title: Don't bring up ethnic labels in public conversation
donts.description: Post-genocide Rwanda emphasizes unified national identity ('Ndi Umunyarwanda' - We are all Rwandans); respect historical memorials.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% is customary in restaurants in Kigali; tipping gorilla tracking guides and trackers ($15-20) in Volcanoes National Park is standard.
